verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API with endpoints covering analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, and labels, plus webhooks and an official MCP server that can act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, all included on the API & MCP plan tier. Nothing in the evidence claims API–UI parity, and many UI capabilities have no documented API surface, including rule authoring, snoozing, canned responses, team and account settings, and chat. missing for 10: explicit parity claim or coverage map, documented API access to rules, snooze, canned responses, settings, and team/chat management, independent or hands-on confirmation of breadth.
